article.headline: Miller’s 20 lead UTEP past Eastern Michigan 72-54
article.description: — Reese Miller scored 20 points as UTEP beat Eastern Michigan 72-54 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Miller’s 20 lead UTEP past Eastern Michigan 72-54
article.story: CANCUN, Mexico -- — Reese Miller scored 20 points as UTEP beat Eastern Michigan 72-54 on Wednesday. Miller went 7 of 11 from the field (5 for 6 from 3-point range) for the Miners (6-1). Jace Whiting shot 4 of 6 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to add 12 points. Leif Moeller had 12 points and shot 4 for 4, including 3 for 3 from beyond the arc. It was the sixth straight victory for the Miners. Emanuel Richards, Kilian Brockhoff and Jabri Fitzpatrick each scored 11 for the Eagles (4-2). UTEP took the lead for good with 9:25 remaining in the first half. The score was 30-24 at halftime, with Moeller racking up eight points. UTEP extended its lead to 53-30 during the second half, fueled by a 20-2 scoring run. Miller scored a team-high 14 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
